description.value:
Requirement You are performing an Install check on your own body, using your own tools.

Self-installs no longer take the field penalty for lacking a proper table.

You've done this to machines a hundred times; doing it to yourself is just a smaller job with worse lighting. When you self-install or self-remove a cyber-augment, ignore the usual −2 circumstance penalty for lacking a proper table. The install still takes the normal recovery — clumsy 1 and drained 1 for the augment's Grade in days — you just don't botch the wiring doing it alone.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 5 -- states a real number (+2 offsetting a -2), but the base penalty it offsets is itself an unencoded homebrew downtime modifier (not found anywhere as a rule element in this pass's scope), so there is no clean predicate/target for a countering FlatModifier to attach to. Not chased into the augment/Install-action implementation -- flagged as an open question, not asserted absent.
